status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Harrison (hamstring) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against Las Vegas.
status.longComment: It's unclear whether the injury is to the same hamstring that limited Harrison's practice participation this past week. He did not log a tackle prior to his exit, and Jackson Woodard is the remaining depth option at linebacker for as long as Harrison is out of the game.
